name: Warehouse 03 — Scanner Cluster Outage & Sorting Degradation
description: Interface buffer overrun on Core Switch SW-03 drops packets to Scanner Gateway Rack 08, triggering 34.2% HTTP 504 timeouts, braking Induction Lines 4-6, and escalating buffer queue to 4,820 parcels.

root_cause.mechanism: Micro-burst input buffer exhaustion resulting in frame discard cascading into HTTP 504 connection drops.
